{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
print("\nNumber of unique patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Show the first few duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_patients = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values('patient_id')
print("\nFirst few duplicate patient IDs:")
print(duplicate_patients[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].head(10))"}
